policy: Merge only when problem, scope, and remedy are materially identical. Keep related but distinct failure modes as separate atomic items.

decisions.reason: They are opposite decision failures: over-reliance on metrics versus ignoring metrics.
They are opposite localization failures with different remediation rules.
Both concern SPA pageview instrumentation, but one overcounts and the other undercounts.
Both infer semantic relations from weak proxies, but folder structure and title text are separate signals.
Both are nondeterministic test inputs, but locale and clock require distinct controls.
Both affect translated content quality, but terminology choice and translation freshness are different problems.
